notes.title: Promo Game Deal during TGS Lyon Game Show
notes.content: Buy your copy of Just Beat Em Up : World of Fury 70% off from september 21st to october 05th 2019.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]New features:[/h1]

[u][b]Charged kick icon added to the UI:[/b][/u]
A gauge is now displayed to help you understanding your charges.

[u][b]Game manual added to the build:[/b][/u]
You can find the move list and the characters specifications in the game manuel located in the install folder of the game.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.02
notes.content:
Optimization :

- All screen resolutions are now supported
- Flamen and Vearfer lifebars are now displayed in the good order

notes.title: Patchnote 1.01
notes.content:
Fixed issues:

- there was a problem when the german language was selected in the game settings
- the magnet card dropped by the warden sometimes got stuck out of playground
- some audio sounds were not affected by the audio strings

Game Balance:

- brigant girls throw knives slightly slower and cannot follow up the projectile by jumping on players anymore
- jump kicks and dash kicks hit harder
- characters speed and constitution are increased in hard, extrem and champion modes
